meta.title: Calendarpit: Local Google Calendar API for tests
meta.description: Calendarpit is a local Google Calendar API v3 and OAuth server for development and tests. Run one Bun process with fixtures, webhooks, and an admin UI.

hero.title: Run a local Google Calendar API for tests
hero.tagline: Calendarpit serves a Google Calendar API v3 subset and local OAuth in one Bun process. Test with no Google account or network access.

diagram.caption: Your app uses standard Google SDKs and API v3 shapes, pointed at Calendarpit on 127.0.0.1.

problem.title: Why test against a local server

before.title: Testing with real Google
items: Needs a Google account, Cloud project, and OAuth setup.
Depends on internet access and shared API quotas.
Shared calendar data changes between test runs.

after.title: Testing with Calendarpit
items: Sign in as a local test user with no real credentials.
Runs on 127.0.0.1 in one process with no network access.
Seed data from fixtures and reset state between tests.

items.title: Google Calendar API
items.text: Manage calendars, events, recurring events, free/busy, and incremental sync with API v3 shapes.

items.title: Local OAuth sign-in
items.text: Pick a test user on the local consent page to issue and refresh tokens with no passwords.

items.title: Fixtures and reset
items.text: Seed users, calendars, events, and clients from a fixture, then reset between test runs.

items.title: Watch webhooks
items.text: Send events.watch notifications to local callbacks and inspect or drain deliveries from tests.

items.title: Admin UI
items.text: Inspect and edit users, calendars, and events in the browser, and read the request history.

items.title: Explicit about gaps
items.text: Unsupported features fail with HTTP 501 (unsupportedFeature), never a silent wrong answer.

items.title: Run Calendarpit locally
items.text: Start the server as a single Bun process backed by SQLite or an in-memory database.

items.title: Point your app at it
items.text: Switch your OAuth and Google Calendar SDK endpoints to the local Calendarpit origin.

items.title: Test with predictable data
items.text: Run your tests, inspect activity in the admin UI, and reset to the startup fixture.

closing.title: Start testing with Calendarpit
closing.text: Calendarpit is built for local development and automated tests only. It implements a defined subset of the Google Calendar API v3 on loopback.
